title: RC 串联的复阻抗
statement: 图示 R = 30 Ω 与 C = 25 µF 串联，正弦稳态角频率 ω = 1000 rad/s。
求 a、b 端的复阻抗 Z = R + jX 的实部、虚部和阻抗角 φ_Z，并判断这个二端网络的性质。

questions.explain: 串联阻抗直接相加，实部就是电阻 30 Ω。

questions.ask: 这个二端网络呈什么性质？端口电压与电流的相位关系如何？
questions.explain: X < 0（φ_Z < 0）为容性。由 U̇ = Z·İ，电压的相位 = 电流的相位 + φ_Z，所以电压滞后电流 53.13°。

hints: 先算容抗 X_C = 1/(ωC)，电容的复阻抗是 −jX_C。
串联：Z = R − jX_C；再把它写成极坐标形式 |Z|∠φ_Z。
solution: **4. 性质。** φ_Z < 0，网络呈**容性**，端口电压滞后电流 53.13°。

en.title: Complex impedance of a series RC
statement: R = 30 Ω is in series with C = 25 µF; the sinusoidal steady state has ω = 1000 rad/s.
Find the real part, the imaginary part and the angle φ_Z of the impedance Z = R + jX seen at terminals a, b, and decide what kind of load this two-terminal network is.

questions.explain: Series impedances simply add; the real part is the 30 Ω resistance.
Capacitive reactance X_C = 1/(ωC) = 1/(1000 × 25×10⁻⁶) = 40 Ω; the capacitor's impedance is −jX_C, so X = −40 Ω.

questions.ask: What kind of network is this, and how are the port voltage and current related in phase?
choices: Capacitive: the voltage lags the current by 53.13°
Inductive: the voltage leads the current by 53.13°
Resistive: voltage and current are in phase
questions.explain: X < 0 (φ_Z < 0) means capacitive. From U̇ = Z·İ, the phase of the voltage = phase of the current + φ_Z, so the voltage lags the current by 53.13°.

hints: First compute the capacitive reactance X_C = 1/(ωC); the capacitor's complex impedance is −jX_C.
Series: Z = R − jX_C; then write it in polar form |Z|∠φ_Z.
solution: **2. Series impedance.** Z = R + Z_C = **30 − j40 Ω**, i.e. R = 30 Ω, X = −40 Ω.
**4. Nature.** φ_Z < 0, so the network is **capacitive**: the port voltage lags the current by 53.13°.
